scenarios.label: Scenario 0: today, real
scenarios.description: Nothing deleted. Derived data and the index are added on top of the originals, so the saving is negative.

scenarios.label: Scenario 1: replace videos
scenarios.description: If an approved process replaced each processed recording by its derived data.
scenarios.formula: A = (O − processed video originals) + D + I

removed.filename: Your Agent Doesnt Need an LLM for Every Decision - Raymond Weitekamp OpenProse.mp4

scenarios.label: Scenario 2: remove exact duplicates
scenarios.description: Keep one copy per SHA-256 group (the earliest upload). Shared or similar slides free nothing, because the files differ.
scenarios.formula: A = (O − extra exact copies) + D + I

scenarios.label: Scenario 3: both
scenarios.description: Scenarios 1 and 2 together, each file counted once.
scenarios.formula: A = (O − processed video originals − extra exact copies, no double counting) + D + I

removed.filename: Your Agent Doesnt Need an LLM for Every Decision - Raymond Weitekamp OpenProse.mp4

information_lost: Motion and live demos in video
Tone of voice (unless the optional audio track is kept)
notes: O = all original bytes in scope, every copy on every simulated system. D = all derived files + manifests. I = measured SQLite/FTS index size.
D and I are counted in every scenario (conservative).
Scenarios 1-3 are hypothetical and require human approval. The tool never deletes anything.
Ericsson's own example (PDF p.2: ~1 GB → ~50 KB text + ~2 MB frames, 'roughly 99%') is their illustration, not our measurement.
